description: A Flutter widget implementing a calculator screen with a stateful UI, supporting basic arithmetic operations, input buffer management, error handling, and layout for calculator buttons.

classes.name: CalculatorScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the calculator UI screen.

classes.name: _CalculatorScreenState
classes.description: State class managing calculator logic, state, and UI for CalculatorScreen.

classes.name: _Operator
classes.description: Enum for arithmetic operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide.

methods.name: _resetAll
methods.description: Resets calculator's internal state and display buffer.

methods.name: _parseInputBuffer
methods.description: Parses the current input buffer into a double value.

methods.name: _formatNumberForDisplay
methods.description: Formats a double value into a string suitable for display, trimming decimals where appropriate.

methods.name: _setErrorState
methods.description: Sets the calculator to an error state, clearing input and resetting flags.

methods.name: _startNewEntry
methods.description: Begins a new number entry with the specified initial string.

methods.name: _onDigit
methods.description: Handles input when a digit button is pressed.

methods.name: _onDecimal
methods.description: Handles input when the decimal point button is pressed.

methods.name: _applyPendingOperator
methods.description: Applies the pending arithmetic operation to the accumulator with the current input.

methods.name: _onOperator
methods.description: Handles when an operator button is pressed, updating pending operation.

methods.name: _onEquals
methods.description: Handles when the '=' button is pressed, performing the pending calculation.

methods.name: _onClear
methods.description: Handles clear button press, resetting calculator state.
